basic_details.job_title: DRDO DHR&V Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 15 DRDO Chair, DRDO Distinguished Fellowships, DRDO Fellowships Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Directorate of Human Resource & Vigilance (DRDO DHR&V)
basic_details.post_name: DRDO Chair, DRDO Distinguished Fellowships, DRDO Fellowships

age_limit.details: Maximum age limit is 5 years after superannuation.

qualification.education_qualification: Retired or due to retire officers from Central Government/Autonomous Body.
qualification.details: DRDO Chair: Distinguished Scientists (DS) or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-16; Retired Lt. General or equivalent in the Pay Level-16. DRDO Distinguished Fellowships: Outstanding Scientists (OS) or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-15; Retired Lt. General or equivalent in the Pay Level-15. DRDO Fellowships: Scientist 'G' or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-14; Retired Major General or equivalent in the Pay Level-14.

salary_details.pay_scale: DRDO Chair: Rs. 1,25,000/- per month, DRDO Distinguished Fellowships: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month, DRDO Fellowships: Rs. 80,000/- per month.
salary_details.details: Fixed monthly honorarium shall be restricted to the amount arrived by deducting the basic pension from the last basic pay drawn at the time of retirement. No annual increment/percentage increased during the contract period. No allowances such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Government Accommodation, Medical reimbursement, Telephone/broadband reimbursement, etc., except Transport Allowance as admissible.

selection_process: Applications received would be examined by a screening committee The shortlisted names recommended by the screening committee would be submitted to the selection committee The selection committee would then recommend the final list
before approval of the Competent Authority
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DRDO DHR&V Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://drdo.gov.in
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: DRDO DHR&V Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DRDO DHR&V Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DRDO DHR&V Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DRDO DHR&V Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: DRDO Chair: Distinguished Scientists (DS) or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-16; Retired Lt. General or equivalent in the Pay Level-16. DRDO Distinguished Fellowships: Outstanding Scientists (OS) or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-15; Retired Lt. General or equivalent in the Pay Level-15. DRDO Fellowships: Scientist 'G' or equivalent from DRDO or other Scientific/Academic Institutions in the Pay Level-14; Retired Major General or equivalent in the Pay Level-14.

content_sections.heading: DRDO DHR&V Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit is 5 years after superannuation.

content_sections.heading: DRDO DHR&V Salary Details 2026
content_sections.text: Fixed monthly honorarium shall be restricted to the amount arrived by deducting the basic pension from the last basic pay drawn at the time of retirement. No annual increment/percentage increased during the contract period. No allowances such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Government Accommodation, Medical reimbursement, Telephone/broadband reimbursement, etc., except Transport Allowance as admissible.

content_sections.heading: DRDO DHR&V Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received would be examined by a screening committee The shortlisted names recommended by the screening committee would be submitted to the selection committee The selection committee would then recommend the final list, before approval of the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DRDO DHR&V Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://drdo.gov.in Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DHR&V recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO DHR&V recruitment is 16 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in the DRDO DHR&V recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers positions for DRDO Chair, DRDO Distinguished Fellowships, and DRDO Fellowships. These are contractual roles for retired or retiring officers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DRDO DHR&V?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies have been announced for the DRDO Chair, DRDO Distinguished Fellowships, and DRDO Fellowships posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility criteria for these positions?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria involve being a retired or due to retire officer from Central Government/Autonomous Body, with specific qualifications and pay levels mentioned for each post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the DRDO Chair position?
faq.answer: The salary for the DRDO Chair position is Rs. 1,25,000/- per month. This is a fixed monthly honorarium.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 5 years after superannuation. Specific age relaxations beyond this are not detailed in the provided summary.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening by a committee, followed by recommendations to a selection committee, and finally approval by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply via email?
faq.answer: An advance copy of the application can be sent to the email address [email protected], but the formal application needs to be submitted offline.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates along with the application form.
